comment: CIV-C10 durable-authorities profile. Import AFTER the databox preset to swap the process-local
InMemory* registries for ResourceStore-backed Durable* ones, so the relationship-mapping, tenant-
binding and source-outbox authorities survive a restart (state persists to pod documents).
The Durable* types redeclare the same registry @ids; the durable definition overrides the
in-memory one. RegistryInitializer instances join PrimaryParallelInitializer so each authority
rehydrates at boot before serving. (The source outbox is smithy-internal — a durable
deployment injects a DurableSourceOutbox via MappingSmithy's `outboxFactory` seam.)

@graph.comment: Durable state documents — one pod resource per authority, over the launch ResourceStore.
Durable registries — same @ids as the in-memory defaults; the durable definition overrides.
Startup hydration — each durable authority rehydrates before the server serves.
Join the durable-authority initializers to the primary startup chain.
